instruction: A cinematic film still of a wide shot capturing a bright indoor ballet studio with white walls and wooden barres. On the left, the red-haired boy (R5) in a dark blue t-shirt and black shorts holds a low, wide squat stance on the floor with his left arm extended. On the right, the short-haired boy (R4) in a dark blue t-shirt and black shorts stands balanced on top of the wooden barre, arms raised to his sides for stability. Both boys look forward with focused expressions. The scene is illuminated by bright, even studio lighting, casting soft shadows against the clean background.
